title: AgentCase
description: The object the Live Billing Monitor hands to Stage 1. This is the ENTIRE input Stage 1 reasons on before deciding which sources to query — keep it lean. Adding fields here that duplicate what a Context API already provides defeats the point of Stage 1 deciding what it needs.

anomaly_type.description: usage_anomaly: cycle-to-date variable spend is above baseline. recurring_anomaly: a newly-posted MRC differs from last cycle. Stage 1's source-selection heuristic branches directly on this.

delta_gbp.description: Signed delta in GBP between actual and expected spend. Positive = higher than expected. Can be negative for recurring_anomaly (e.g. a promo just started) — confirm downstream logic handles the negative case, the POC's mock scenarios only exercise positive deltas.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Assumption: multi-currency supported.

contributing_events.description: The raw OCS event(s) that drove this anomaly.

detected_at.description: Date the monitor evaluated and flagged this anomaly (the 'as of' scan date, not the event timestamp).
